description: Defines a finite state machine class for managing the ZeroMQ radio transmit channel, including state transitions, timers, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: radio_zmq_tx_channel_fsm
classes.description: Finite state machine managing the ZeroMQ radio transmit channel states, transitions, and timers.

methods.name: init_successful
methods.description: Sets the state to WAIT_START after successful initialization.

methods.name: on_start
methods.description: Transitions to WAIT_REQUEST and starts the timer when processing begins.

methods.name: on_error
methods.description: Transitions to STOPPED state upon error.

methods.name: request_received
methods.description: Transitions from WAIT_REQUEST to WAIT_DATA and restarts the timer upon receiving a request.

methods.name: data_sent
methods.description: Transitions from WAIT_DATA to WAIT_REQUEST and restarts the timer after data is sent.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Transitions to STOPPED if the channel is running.

methods.name: async_task_stopped
methods.description: Transitions to STOPPED when the asynchronous task stops.

methods.name: is_initiated
methods.description: Checks if the channel has been initialized (state > UNINITIALIZED).

methods.name: is_running
methods.description: Checks if the channel is in a running state (WAIT_REQUEST or WAIT_DATA).

methods.name: has_pending_request
methods.description: Returns true if the current state is WAIT_DATA.

methods.name: has_wait_expired
methods.description: Checks if the wait timer has expired and resets it if so.
